latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the local-first cron scheduler skill.

- Capture recurring jobs and schedules in natural language.
- Fully local execution and storage—no external sync or cloud required.
- Supports daily, weekly, monthly, and interval-based schedules.
- Manage jobs: add, pause, resume, archive, and review all schedules.
- Surfaces upcoming execution times and job status (active, paused, archived).
